cards.verse_text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.

cards.card_text: Solomon even points to the signals: he who winks his eye devises perversity, and he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
cards.verse_text: He who winks his eye devises perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
cards.snippet: He who winks his eye devises perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.

cards.card_text: The writer says the drinker's eyes will see ___ things and his mind will utter perversities.
cards.verse_text: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
cards.snippet: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.

cards.card_text: The iniquity of Israel and Judah isn't just great but EXCEEDINGLY great, with bloodshed filling the land and perversity filling the city.
cards.verse_text: The land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of perversity.
cards.snippet: The land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of perversity.
